body:
Next coordinated all-host restart: what to bundle and ask (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13 07:10Z). Remove this memory after that restart is verified.
TIMING: after Engram's rollback hold ends (~09:00Z review) and the pending landings install, agreed with Engram::Fable.
GREG-ACT WINDOW: this restart is also K3 S2b's reader-floor window (Engram::Fable #7784). That means: no drain before Greg's „zaczynam”; one RESET NOW from Fable2 through Engram::Asistant; a one-shot wake at start+15; and before anyone resumes, a check that every host's running engram meets S2b's floor (c593 is sending Engram::Fable the exact check; w-180d may have to install on every host first).
HOSTS: Central, DL560, Mac. DL560 still runs 42851443; the Mac runs 62a4785a.
BUNDLED TermAl landings to carry: w-0419, aa01 (combo87), the 4bd8 trace, K3 S2b, plus whatever lands before.
ASK GREG in the RESET NOW message: after start, paste 60-120 s of the RAW Central console, or a lines-per-minute count, for w-c490bb137423 C5 (console rate after the landing).
AFTER: tell Engram::Fable "all hosts carry <master>" (unblocks its w-a82d). Opus2's combo closures need the release binary on Central and DL560, so they request evaluations one at a time.

07:12Z correction (c593 #1827). S2b's "reader floor" is TermAl's OWN SQLite formats: MAIN gains -test-request-custody-1 (src/persist.rs:49-51), and COORD becomes 8-direct-prompt-1-test-request-custody-1 (src/coordination_persist.rs:20-21). There is NO Engram build or capability prerequisite. So the per-host check after restart is that the TermAl MAIN and COORD stores migrated and the host is up, not an Engram floor.
Open questions asked of c593: can a pre-S2b build open the migrated stores (the rollback path, and whether a backup is kept), and is mixed-version federation safe during a staggered restart? Answer both before asking Greg for the window.

07:16Z, S2b window requirements (c593 #1831, from source at e45d; docs/features/test-runs.md "Old TermAl binaries refuse both upgraded stores"):
(1) The migration is ONE-WAY for both MAIN (termal.sqlite) and COORD (coordination.sqlite). There is no automatic pre-migration copy and no cross-database transaction. Rollback = restore BOTH matching pre-install backups and run the old exe; swapping the exe alone is insufficient. The realistic default is roll-forward. So the window's Greg act on EACH host (Central, DL560, Mac) is: stop TermAl, then copy MAIN+COORD as a matched pair to a dated backup folder (Greg's data; agents never open ~/.termal), then start the new build. Write the exact per-host steps for Greg before the window.
(2) Mixed versions: ordinary mail stays compatible (relay v1; the optional field is omitted). TYPED test_request mail is refused by any pre-S2b home or reader. Rule: NO agent sends test_request-typed mail until every host is confirmed on S2b after the window. Tell all coders when the window opens.
